text: Declared a bounded reference diagnostic before new outcomes: regularized-reference-v1/protocol.json, observed OASIS 11->12 only, two standard SyNOnly/CC lanes with identical saved affine/input masks and deterministic seed. Both use caps 100/70/200; lane one retains native total_sigma=0, lane two uses total_sigma=0.5 (native ANTs parameter, not asserted equivalent to HalfFlow's physical sigma). Existing generous references stopped by native convergence at coarse/middle levels but all three hit fine cap40, while native original transforms already show inverse error, so this separates additional fine convergence from accumulated-field regularity. No custom inverse projection and no anatomy-selected parameter sweep. One reference worker, one native thread, one-hour fit deadline, all outcomes retained. This may overlap the separately sealed HalfFlow diagnostic panel; wall times are explicitly excluded from production comparison. Common inverse/coverage/cell thresholds unchanged. Native convergence must be evidenced before cap; neither pilot lane can promote a reference alone. Follow-up cohort validation must be separately declared after both results. Prior studies and their frozen source copies remain immutable.
